flags.why: The example defines the proletariat instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Ông ấy viết một cuốn sách về giai cấp vô sản. = He wrote a book about the proletariat.

flags.why: Using bằng directly with giao thông công cộng is unnatural here because the sentence needs a means of transport.
flags.fix: Đi làm bằng phương tiện giao thông công cộng rẻ hơn lái xe. = Going to work by public transport is cheaper than driving.

flags.why: The example explains what an intersection line is instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Hãy tìm giao tuyến của hai mặt phẳng này. = Find the line of intersection of these two planes.

flags.why: Giun chỉ includes several filarial worm species, so identifying it exclusively as Wuchereria bancrofti is incorrect ([Vinmec](https://www.vinmec.com/vie/benh/giun-chi-3144)).

The expression disparages older people for interests or behaviour deemed inappropriate for their age ([linguistic study](https://dulieu.itrithuc.vn/media/dataset/2020_08/4230-73-7930-1-10-20180316.pdf)).
An old man literally playing a toy drum is a compositional description of the idiom's imagery, not a separate dictionary meaning.
